_MAX_ARTIFACT_DEPTH = 16
_MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES = 128 * 1024
_CLEANUP_SECONDS = 2.0


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ToolSpec:
    """Resolution contract for an optional executable."""

    tool_id: str
    candidates: tuple[str, ...]
    environment_variable: str
    homepage: str
    license: str
    version_arguments: tuple[str, ...] = ("--version",)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ResolvedTool:
    """Resolved executable prefix."""

    path: str
    command_prefix: tuple[str, ...]
    source: str


class ToolRunner:
    """Resolve and execute allow-listed tools without invoking a shell."""

    def __init__(self, spec: ToolSpec) -> None:
        self.spec = spec

    def resolve(self) -> ResolvedTool | None:
        override = os.getenv(self.spec.environment_variable)
        if override:
            path = Path(override).expanduser()
            if path.is_file() and (path.suffix.lower() == ".py" or os.access(path, os.X_OK)):
                return self._resolved(str(path.resolve()), "environment")
            # An explicitly configured but invalid path must not select an
            # unrelated executable from PATH instead.
            return None

        for candidate in self.spec.candidates:
            discovered = shutil.which(candidate)
            if discovered:
                return self._resolved(str(Path(discovered).resolve()), "path")
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _resolved(path: str, source: str) -> ResolvedTool:
        if Path(path).suffix.lower() in {".bat", ".cmd"}:
            raise ValueError("batch command wrappers are not supported; configure a native executable or .py file")
        prefix = (sys.executable, path) if path.lower().endswith(".py") else (path,)
        return ResolvedTool(path=path, command_prefix=prefix, source=source)

    def health(self) -> PluginHealth:
        try:
            resolved = self.resolve()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return PluginHealth(available=False, status="invalid_configuration",
                                message=f"{self.spec.environment_variable} must select a usable native executable or .py file")
        if resolved is None:
            candidates = ", ".join(self.spec.candidates)
            return PluginHealth(
                available=False,
                status="optional_dependency_missing",
                message=(
                    f"{self.spec.tool_id} is not installed; set {self.spec.environment_variable} "
                    f"or install one of: {candidates}"
                ),
                details={
                    "tool": self.spec.tool_id,
                    "homepage": self.spec.homepage,
                    "license": self.spec.license,
                    "environment_variable": self.spec.environment_variable,
                },
            )
        return PluginHealth(
            available=True,
            details={
                "tool": self.spec.tool_id,
                "path": resolved.path,
                "source": resolved.source,
                "homepage": self.spec.homepage,
                "license": self.spec.license,
            },
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _drain(pipe: BinaryIO, buffer: bytearray, overflow: list[bool]) -> None:
        """Always drain pipes; retain only bounded output in memory."""
        try:
            while True:
                chunk = pipe.read(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                available = max(0, _MAX_STREAM_BYTES - len(buffer))
                buffer.extend(chunk[:available])
                if len(chunk) > available:
                    overflow[0] = True
        finally:
            pipe.close()

    @staticmethod
    def _stop_process(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
        """Compatibility helper for a dedicated POSIX group or one child."""
        stop_process(process)

    def run(
        self,
        arguments: Sequence[str],
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float,
        environment: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
        working_directory: str | Path | None = None,
    ) -> JsonObject:
        if type(timeout_seconds) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(timeout_seconds) or timeout_seconds <= 0:
            raise ValueError("timeout_seconds must be finite and positive")
        if isinstance(arguments, (str, bytes)) or len(arguments) > 1024:
            raise ValueError("tool arguments must be a bounded sequence of strings")
        if any(not isinstance(argument, str) or any(ord(char) < 32 for char in argument) for argument in arguments):
            raise ValueError("tool arguments must be strings without control characters or NUL bytes")
        if sum(len(argument.encode("utf-8")) + 1 for argument in arguments) > _MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES:
            raise ValueError("tool arguments exceed the 128 KiB limit")
        env = self._environment(environment)
        resolved = self.resolve()
        if resolved is None:
            raise ToolUnavailableError(self.health().message)
        command = [*resolved.command_prefix, *arguments]
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes = bytearray(), bytearray()
        stdout_overflow, stderr_overflow = [False], [False]
        # HOME and temporary paths are private to this invocation. A trusted
        # adapter may select its installed resources as cwd, but no caller may
        # inject another home/config directory through environment overrides.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="orion-exec-") as private_home, execution_scope(timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds):
            for key in ("HOME", "USERPROFILE", "TMP", "TEMP", "TMPDIR", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME"):
                env[key] = private_home
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                command,
                cwd=str(working_directory) if working_directory is not None else private_home,
                env=env,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                shell=False,
                start_new_session=os.name == "posix",
                creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0) if os.name == "nt" else 0,
            )
            group: ProcessGroup | None = None
            readers: list[threading.Thread] = []
            try:
                group = ProcessGroup(process)
                if process.stdout is None or process.stderr is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("tool output pipes could not be initialized")
                for label, pipe, buffer, overflow in (
                    ("stdout", process.stdout, stdout_bytes, stdout_overflow),
                    ("stderr", process.stderr, stderr_bytes, stderr_overflow),
                ):
                    reader = threading.Thread(target=self._drain, args=(pipe, buffer, overflow),
                                              name=f"orion-tool-{label}", daemon=True)
                    reader.start()
                    readers.append(reader)
                while True:
                    check_execution()
                    try:
                        return_code = process.wait(timeout=remaining_timeout(0.05))
                        break
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        continue
            finally:
                # Also runs for cancellation, KeyboardInterrupt, reader setup
                # errors, and successful parents that left children behind.
                if group is not None:
                    group.stop()
                else:
                    self._stop_process(process)
                cleanup_deadline = time.monotonic() + _CLEANUP_SECONDS
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=max(0.001, cleanup_deadline - time.monotonic()))
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    self._stop_process(process)
                for reader in readers:
                    reader.join(timeout=max(0, cleanup_deadline - time.monotonic()))
                if not readers:
                    for stream in (process.stdout, process.stderr):
                        if stream is not None:
                            stream.close()
            if any(reader.is_alive() for reader in readers):
                raise RuntimeError(f"{self.spec.tool_id} retained open subprocess output handles after cleanup")
            check_execution()
        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1_000_000)

        stdout = redact_text(self._decode(bytes(stdout_bytes)), environment)
        stderr = redact_text(self._decode(bytes(stderr_bytes)), environment)
        if stdout_overflow[0]:
            stdout += "\n[ORION STDOUT TRUNCATED AT 2 MiB]"
        if stderr_overflow[0]:
            stderr += "\n[ORION STDERR TRUNCATED AT 2 MiB]"
        result: JsonObject = {
            "tool": self.spec.tool_id,
            "return_code": return_code,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "stdout": stdout,
            "stderr": stderr,
            "stdout_truncated": stdout_overflow[0],
            "stderr_truncated": stderr_overflow[0],
        }
        if return_code != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{self.spec.tool_id} exited with code {return_code}: {(stderr or stdout)[:2048]}"
            )
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _environment(extra: Mapping[str, str] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
        allowed = {
            "PATH",
            "LANG",
            "LC_ALL",
            "SYSTEMROOT",
            "WINDIR",
        }
        env = {key.upper(): value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key.upper() in allowed}
        env.setdefault("PYTHONUNBUFFERED", "1")
        if extra:
            if len(extra) > 32:
                raise ValueError("too many tool environment overrides")
            blocked = allowed | {
                "HOME", "USERPROFILE", "APPDATA", "LOCALAPPDATA", "TMP", "TEMP", "TMPDIR",
                "COMSPEC", "PATHEXT", "BASH_ENV", "BASHOPTS", "ENV", "IFS", "SHELLOPTS", "CDPATH",
                "NODE_OPTIONS", "NODE_PATH", "RUBYOPT", "RUBYLIB", "PERL5OPT", "PERL5LIB", "PERLLIB",
                "JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS", "CLASSPATH",
                "GCONV_PATH", "LOCPATH", "SSLKEYLOGFILE", "SSL_CERT_FILE", "SSL_CERT_DIR",
                "REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE", "CURL_CA_BUNDLE", "HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "NO_PROXY",
                "GODEBUG", "R_PROFILE", "R_PROFILE_USER", "R_ENVIRON", "R_ENVIRON_USER",
            }
            names: set[str] = set()
            for key, value in extra.items():
                if not isinstance(key, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}", key) is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"invalid environment variable name: {key!r}")
                normalized = key.upper()
                protected_prefixes = (
                    "DYLD_", "LD_", "PYTHON", "XDG_", "GIT_", "SSH_", "ORION_", "OPENSSL_", "NODE_",
                    "DOTNET_", "CORECLR_", "COR_", "LUA_", "TCL_", "TK_", "QT_", "GTK_", "GIO_", "GI_",
                )
                if normalized in blocked or (normalized.startswith(protected_prefixes) and not normalized.startswith("ORION_TOOL_")):
                    raise ValueError(f"protected environment variable cannot be overridden: {key!r}")
                if normalized in names:
                    raise ValueError("duplicate case-insensitive environment variable name")
                if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 4096 or "\x00" in value:
                    raise ValueError(f"invalid environment variable value for {key!r}")
                names.add(normalized)
                env[key] = value
        return env

    @staticmethod
    def _decode(value: bytes | str | None) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        raw = value if isinstance(value, bytes) else value.encode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if len(raw) > _MAX_STREAM_BYTES:
            raw = raw[:_MAX_STREAM_BYTES] + b"\n[ORION OUTPUT TRUNCATED]"
        return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()


def parse_json_output(text: str) -> Any | None:
    """Parse bounded strict JSON, or one of the last 256 tool output lines."""

    if len(text) > _MAX_STREAM_BYTES or len(text.encode("utf-8")) > _MAX_STREAM_BYTES:
        # A truncated byte stream is evidence, not a complete JSON document.
        return None
    stripped = text.strip()
    if not stripped:
        return None
    try:
        return loads_json(stripped, max_bytes=_MAX_STREAM_BYTES)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    for line in reversed(stripped.rsplit("\n", 256)[-256:]):
        candidate = line.strip()
        if candidate.startswith(("{", "[")):
            try:
                return loads_json(candidate, max_bytes=_MAX_STREAM_BYTES)
            except ValueError:
                continue
    return None


def collect_artifacts(root: str | Path) -> JsonObject:
    """Read bounded regular artifacts without traversing links or special files.

    POSIX traversal opens each directory relative to its parent descriptor with
    O_NOFOLLOW. Windows rejects reparse points and checks the opened file identity.
    This bounds collection, not disk consumption by the external executable.
    """
    supplied = Path(root)
    if supplied.is_symlink() or getattr(supplied.lstat(), "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400:
        raise ValueError("artifact root must not be a symbolic link or reparse point")
    base = supplied.resolve(strict=True)
    if not base.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("artifact root must be a directory")
    files: JsonObject = {}
    consumed = 0
    visited = 0
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK", 0)
    descriptor_walk = os.open in os.supports_dir_fd and os.scandir in os.supports_fd

    def regular_artifact(descriptor: int, relative: Path, expected: os.stat_result) -> None:
        nonlocal consumed
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as handle:
            info = os.fstat(handle.fileno())
            if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1
                    or (info.st_dev, info.st_ino) != (expected.st_dev, expected.st_ino)):
                return
            if len(files) >= _MAX_ARTIFACT_FILES:
                raise ValueError("artifact file count exceeds the 256-file limit")
            remaining = _MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES - consumed
            name = str(relative)
            if info.st_size > remaining:
                files[name] = {"truncated": True, "size_bytes": info.st_size}
                return
            raw = handle.read(remaining + 1)
            if len(raw) > remaining:
                files[name] = {"truncated": True, "size_bytes": max(info.st_size, len(raw))}
                return
            consumed += len(raw)
        if relative.suffix.lower() == ".json":
            try:
                files[name] = loads_json(raw, max_bytes=_MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES)
                return
            except ValueError:
                pass
        files[name] = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    def walk(directory: int | Path, relative: Path, depth: int) -> None:
        nonlocal visited
        entries: list[os.DirEntry[str]] = []
        with os.scandir(directory) as scan:
            for entry in scan:
                visited += 1
                if visited > _MAX_ARTIFACT_ENTRIES:
                    raise ValueError("artifact directory entry budget exceeded")
                entries.append(entry)
        for entry in sorted(entries, key=lambda item: item.name):
            check_execution()
            try:
                info = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                continue
            if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400:
                continue  # Includes Windows junctions and other reparse points.
            child = relative / entry.name
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                if depth >= _MAX_ARTIFACT_DEPTH:
                    raise ValueError("artifact directory nesting exceeds 16 levels")
                if isinstance(directory, int):
                    try:
                        child_fd = os.open(entry.name, flags | os.O_DIRECTORY, dir_fd=directory)
                    except FileNotFoundError:
                        continue
                    try:
                        walk(child_fd, child, depth + 1)
                    finally:
                        os.close(child_fd)
                else:
                    walk(directory / entry.name, child, depth + 1)
            elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1:
                try:
                    descriptor = (os.open(entry.name, flags, dir_fd=directory) if isinstance(directory, int)
                                  else os.open(directory / entry.name, flags))
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    continue
                regular_artifact(descriptor, child, info)

    if descriptor_walk:
        root_fd = os.open(base, flags | os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            walk(root_fd, Path(), 0)
        finally:
            os.close(root_fd)
    else:
        walk(base, Path(), 0)
    return {name: files[name] for name in sorted(files)}


class TemporaryToolDirectory:
    """Context manager exposing a private temporary directory to adapters."""

    def __init__(self, prefix: str) -> None:
        self._temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=prefix)
        self.path = Path(self._temporary.name)

    def __enter__(self) -> Path:
        return self.path

    def __exit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, traceback: object) -> None:
        self._temporary.cleanup()

"""Plugins oficiales incluidos en ORION.""" from __future__ import annotations from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

"""Plugins oficiales incluidos en ORION."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from contextvars import copy_context
from typing import Callable, Iterable

from .core import BasePlugin, JsonObject, PluginContext, PluginMetadata
from .execution import ExecutionCancelledError, check_execution, remaining_timeout


def _workers(payload: JsonObject, item_count: int) -> int:
    requested = int(payload.get("workers", 4))
    return max(1, min(requested, max(1, item_count), 32))


def _parallel_map(function: Callable[[str], JsonObject], values: Iterable[str], workers: int) -> list[JsonObject]:
    ordered_values = list(values)

    def checked(value: str) -> JsonObject:
        check_execution()
        result = function(value)
        check_execution()
        return result

    if workers == 1 or len(ordered_values) <= 1:
        return [checked(value) for value in ordered_values]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers, thread_name_prefix="orion-plugin") as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(copy_context().run, checked, value) for value in ordered_values]
        try:
            return [future.result() for future in futures]
        except BaseException:
            for future in futures:
                future.cancel()
            raise


class IocEnricherPlugin(BasePlugin):
    metadata = PluginMetadata(
        plugin_id="ioc_enricher",
        name="IOC Enricher",
        version="1.0.0",
        category="osint-intelligence",
        description="Clasifica indicadores localmente; las consultas DNS y fuentes externas están bloqueadas por el perfil controlado.",
        risk_level="low",
        capabilities=("ioc-classification", "dns-resolution", "threat-intelligence"),
        requires_authorization=True,
        network_access=True,
        side_effects=False,
        default_timeout_seconds=30,
        max_timeout_seconds=300,
        tags=("ioc", "osint", "defensive", "json-first"),
        input_schema={
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["iocs"],
            "additionalProperties": False,
            "properties": {
                "iocs": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 1,
                    "maxItems": 500,
                    "uniqueItems": True,
                    "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 2048},
                },
                "timeout": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0.1, "maximum": 30},
                "workers": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 32},
                "external_sources": {"type": "boolean"},
            },
        },
        output_schema={
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["tool", "count", "items"],
            "properties": {
                "tool": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ioc_enricher"]},
                "count": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
                "items": {"type": "array"},
            },
        },
    )

    @staticmethod
    def _local_record(value: str) -> JsonObject:
        """One offline implementation shared by the CLI and plugin runtime."""
        from orion.scripts import ioc_enricher as engine

        return engine.build_record(value, 5.0, allow_network=False)

    def run(self, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> JsonObject:
        from orion.scripts import ioc_enricher as engine

        payload = self.authorize(payload, context)
        del context
        iocs = list(dict.fromkeys(item.strip() for item in payload["iocs"] if item.strip()))
        timeout = float(payload.get("timeout", 5.0))
        external_sources = bool(payload.get("external_sources", False))
        build = (lambda value: engine.build_record(value, remaining_timeout(timeout), allow_network=True)) if external_sources else self._local_record
        items = _parallel_map(build, iocs, _workers(payload, len(iocs)))
        return {"tool": "ioc_enricher", "count": len(items), "items": items}


class TlsPostureAuditPlugin(BasePlugin):
    metadata = PluginMetadata(
        plugin_id="tls_posture_audit",
        name="TLS Posture Audit",
        version="1.0.0",
        category="web-network",
        description="Inspecciona negociación TLS y certificados de endpoints autorizados.",
        risk_level="low",
        capabilities=("tls-inspection", "certificate-inventory"),
        requires_authorization=True,
        network_access=True,
        side_effects=False,
        default_timeout_seconds=30,
        max_timeout_seconds=300,
        tags=("tls", "certificate", "defensive", "read-only"),
        input_schema={
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["targets"],
            "additionalProperties": False,
            "properties": {
                "targets": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 1,
                    "maxItems": 500,
                    "uniqueItems": True,
                    "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 255},
                },
                "timeout": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0.1, "maximum": 30},
                "workers": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 32},
            },
        },
        output_schema={
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["tool", "count", "items"],
            "properties": {
                "tool": {"type": "string", "enum": ["tls_posture_audit"]},
                "count": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
                "items": {"type": "array"},
            },
        },
    )

    def run(self, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> JsonObject:
        from orion.scripts import tls_posture_audit as engine

        payload = self.authorize(payload, context)
        del context
        targets = list(dict.fromkeys(item.strip() for item in payload["targets"] if item.strip()))
        timeout = float(payload.get("timeout", 5.0))

        def audit(target: str) -> JsonObject:
            try:
                return engine.audit_target(target, remaining_timeout(timeout))
            except ExecutionCancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                return {"target": target, "error": str(exc), "error_type": type(exc).__name__}

        items = _parallel_map(audit, targets, _workers(payload, len(targets)))
        return {"tool": "tls_posture_audit", "count": len(items), "items": items}


class FindingsTicketSyncPlugin(BasePlugin):

            "additionalProperties": False,
            "properties": {

                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 1,
                    "maxItems": 1000,
                    "items": {"type": "object"},
                },
                "mode": {"type": "string", "enum": ["plan", "jira", "servicenow"]},
                "apply": {"type": "boolean"},
            },
        },
        output_schema={
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["tool", "mode", "count", "items"],
            "properties": {
                "tool": {"type": "string", "enum": ["findings_ticket_sync"]},
                "mode": {"type": "string"},
                "count": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
                "items": {"type": "array"},
                "created": {"type": "array"},
            },
        },
    )

    def run(self, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> JsonObject:
        from orion.scripts import findings_ticket_sync as engine

        payload = self.authorize(payload, context)
        findings = payload["findings"]
        mode = str(payload.get("mode", "plan"))
        apply = bool(payload.get("apply", False))
        plan = engine.build_plan(findings, mode)
        result: JsonObject = {
            "tool": "findings_ticket_sync",
            "mode": mode,
            "count": len(plan),
            "items": plan,
        }
        if apply:
            if mode == "plan":
                raise ValueError("apply=true no es válido cuando mode=plan")
            if not context.allow_network:
                raise PermissionError("La creación de tickets también requiere allow_network=true")
            result["created"] = engine.apply_jira(plan) if mode == "jira" else engine.apply_servicenow(plan)
        return result

import importlib.metadata

)

from .execution import ExecutionCancelledError, check_execution, execution_scope
from .redaction import redact_data, redact_text

JsonObject = dict[str, Any]
_ADMITTED_REQUEST: ContextVar[tuple[int, int, int] | None] = ContextVar("orion_admitted_request", default=None)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PluginHealth:
    """Availability report for a plugin and its optional dependencies."""
    available: bool
    status: str = "ready"
    message: str = ""
    details: JsonObject = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> JsonObject:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PluginMetadata:
    """Immutable, machine-readable contract for an ORION plugin."""
    plugin_id: str
    name: str
    version: str
    category: str
    description: str
    risk_level: str
    capabilities: tuple[str, ...]
    input_schema: JsonObject
    output_schema: JsonObject
    requires_authorization: bool = True
    network_access: bool = False
    side_effects: bool = False
    default_timeout_seconds: float = 30.0
    max_timeout_seconds: float = 300.0
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    homepage: str | None = None
    license: str | None = None
    integration: str = "native"

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{2,63}", self.plugin_id):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid plugin_id: {self.plugin_id!r}")
        if not self.name.strip():
            raise ValueError("name cannot be empty")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:[-+][A-Za-z0-9.-]+)?", self.version):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid semantic version: {self.version!r}")
        if self.risk_level not in {"low", "medium", "high"}:
            raise ValueError("risk_level must be low, medium, or high")
        if not self.capabilities:
            raise ValueError("capabilities must contain at least one item")
        if any(type(value) is not bool for value in (self.requires_authorization, self.network_access, self.side_effects)):
            raise ValueError("plugin authorization and effect flags must be booleans")
        if type(self.default_timeout_seconds) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(self.default_timeout_seconds) or self.default_timeout_seconds <= 0:
            raise ValueError("default_timeout_seconds must be finite and positive")
        if type(self.max_timeout_seconds) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(self.max_timeout_seconds) or self.max_timeout_seconds < self.default_timeout_seconds:
            raise ValueError("max_timeout_seconds must be finite and cannot be lower than the default")
        if self.input_schema.get("type") != "object":
            raise ValueError("input_schema must declare type=object")
        if self.output_schema.get("type") not in {"object", "array"}:
            raise ValueError("output_schema must declare type=object or type=array")

    def to_dict(self) -> JsonObject:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["capabilities"] = list(self.capabilities)
        payload["tags"] = list(self.tags)
        return payload


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PluginContext:
    """Explicit execution context. Actor is an audit label, not an authenticated identity."""
    authorization: str | None = None
    allow_network: bool = False
    allow_side_effects: bool = False
    actor: str = "local-user"
    request_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    environment: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.actor, str) or not 1 <= len(self.actor.strip()) <= 128:
            raise ValueError("actor must contain 1 to 128 characters")
        if any(ord(char) < 32 for char in self.actor):
            raise ValueError("actor must not contain control characters")
        if self.authorization is not None and (not isinstance(self.authorization, str) or len(self.authorization) > 512):
            raise ValueError("authorization must be a reference of at most 512 characters")
        if type(self.allow_network) is not bool or type(self.allow_side_effects) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("permission flags must be booleans")
        if not isinstance(self.environment, Mapping) or len(self.environment) > 32:
            raise ValueError("environment must be a mapping with at most 32 entries")
        for key, value in self.environment.items():
            if (not isinstance(key, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}", key) is None
                    or not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 4096 or "\x00" in value):
                raise ValueError("environment entries must have valid names and bounded string values")
        # A frozen dataclass alone does not freeze a caller-owned dictionary.
        object.__setattr__(self, "environment", MappingProxyType(dict(self.environment)))
        try:
            uuid.UUID(self.request_id)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
            raise ValueError("request_id must be a valid UUID") from exc


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PluginResult:
    """Normalized result for CLI, MCP, agents, and pipelines."""
    plugin_id: str
    plugin_version: str
    request_id: str
    actor: str
    ok: bool
    duration_ms: int
    data: JsonObject | list[Any] | None = None
    warnings: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    error: JsonObject | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> JsonObject:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["warnings"] = list(self.warnings)
        return payload


class BasePlugin(ABC):
    """Stable interface implemented by internal and explicitly trusted plugins."""
    metadata: PluginMetadata

    @abstractmethod
    def run(self, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> JsonObject | list[Any]:
        """Execute the plugin and return a JSON-serializable value."""

    def health(self) -> PluginHealth:
        return PluginHealth(available=True)

    def requests_side_effects(self, payload: JsonObject) -> bool:
        return self.metadata.side_effects and bool(payload.get("apply"))

    def authorize(self, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> JsonObject:
        """Apply the normal policy to direct calls as well as runtime calls.

        Official plugins call this before work. The runtime's exact object
        binding reuses an existing admission without consuming a lab approval
        twice. External Python plugins remain explicitly trusted code.
        """
        admitted = _ADMITTED_REQUEST.get() == (id(self), id(payload), id(context))
        if not admitted:
            try:
                payload = json.loads(canonical_json(payload))
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise InputValidationError(str(exc)) from exc
        validate_json_schema(payload, self.metadata.input_schema)
        if not admitted:
            ExecutionPolicy().validate(self, payload, context)
        check_execution()
        return payload


class ExecutionPolicy:
    """Centralized authorization with operator-provisioned controlled-lab approval."""

    def validate(self, plugin: BasePlugin, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> None:
        metadata = plugin.metadata
        authorization = (context.authorization or "").strip()
        if metadata.requires_authorization and len(authorization) < 12:
            raise AuthorizationError("an explicit authorization reference is required")
        effects = plugin.requests_side_effects(payload)
        network = needs_network(metadata.plugin_id, payload, metadata.network_access, effects)
        if network and not context.allow_network:
            raise AuthorizationError(f"plugin {metadata.plugin_id} requires explicit network permission")
        if effects and not context.allow_side_effects:
            raise AuthorizationError(f"plugin {metadata.plugin_id} requires explicit side-effect permission")
        try:
            enforce_request(metadata.plugin_id, payload, authorization=authorization, actor=context.actor,
                            request_id=context.request_id, network=network, side_effects=effects)
        except ControlDenied as exc:
            raise AuthorizationError(str(exc)) from exc
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise AuthorizationError("controlled-operation configuration is invalid or inaccessible") from exc


class PluginRegistry:
    """Deterministic registry. Loading external Python code requires explicit opt-in."""
    ENTRY_POINT_GROUP = "orion.plugins"

    def __init__(self, *, load_external: bool = False) -> None:
        self._plugins: MutableMapping[str, BasePlugin] = {}
        self._discovery_errors: list[JsonObject] = []
        self._load_builtins()
        if load_external:
            self._load_entry_points()

    @property
    def discovery_errors(self) -> tuple[JsonObject, ...]:
        return tuple(self._discovery_errors)

    def _load_builtins(self) -> None:
        from .builtin import BUILTIN_PLUGINS
        from .osint import OSINT_PLUGINS
        for plugin_type in (*BUILTIN_PLUGINS, *OSINT_PLUGINS):
            self.register(plugin_type())

    def _load_entry_points(self) -> None:
        entry_points = importlib.metadata.entry_points()
        selected: Iterable[Any]
        if hasattr(entry_points, "select"):
            selected = entry_points.select(group=self.ENTRY_POINT_GROUP)
        else:  # pragma: no cover
            selected = entry_points.get(self.ENTRY_POINT_GROUP, [])
        for entry_point in selected:
            try:
                loaded = entry_point.load()
                plugin = loaded() if isinstance(loaded, type) else loaded
                if not isinstance(plugin, BasePlugin):
                    raise TypeError(f"entry point {entry_point.name!r} does not implement BasePlugin")
                if plugin.metadata.plugin_id in self._plugins:
                    continue
                self.register(plugin)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                self._discovery_errors.append({"entry_point": entry_point.name, "type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})

    def register(self, plugin: BasePlugin) -> None:
        if not isinstance(plugin, BasePlugin):
            raise TypeError("plugin must implement BasePlugin")
        plugin_id = plugin.metadata.plugin_id
        if plugin_id in self._plugins:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate plugin: {plugin_id}")
        self._plugins[plugin_id] = plugin

    def get(self, plugin_id: str) -> BasePlugin:
        try:
            return self._plugins[plugin_id]
        except KeyError as exc:
            available = ", ".join(sorted(self._plugins))
            raise PluginNotFoundError(f"plugin not found: {plugin_id}; available: {available}") from exc

    def list(self) -> tuple[BasePlugin, ...]:
        return tuple(self._plugins[key] for key in sorted(self._plugins))

    def health(self) -> JsonObject:
        return {plugin.metadata.plugin_id: plugin.health().to_dict() for plugin in self.list()}

    def manifest(self) -> JsonObject:
        from orion import __version__
        return {"manifest_version": "2.0", "runtime": {
            "name": "orion-hacking-etico", "version": __version__,
            "python_runtime": platform.python_version(), "minimum_python": "3.10",
            "entry_point_group": self.ENTRY_POINT_GROUP,
        }, "plugins": [plugin.metadata.to_dict() for plugin in self.list()]}


class OrionRuntime:
    """Uniform facade with cooperative deadlines and immutable request snapshots.

    Native Python plugins must cooperate with cancellation. External ToolRunner
    processes enforce the inherited deadline while the runtime rejects late data.
    """

    def __init__(self, registry: PluginRegistry | None = None, policy: ExecutionPolicy | None = None) -> None:
        self.registry = registry or PluginRegistry()
        self.policy = policy or ExecutionPolicy()

    def execute(self, plugin_id: str, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext, *,
                timeout_seconds: float | None = None, raise_errors: bool = False) -> PluginResult:
        plugin = self.registry.get(plugin_id)
        metadata = plugin.metadata
        timeout = timeout_seconds if timeout_seconds is not None else metadata.default_timeout_seconds
        if type(timeout) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0 or timeout > metadata.max_timeout_seconds:
            raise InputValidationError(f"timeout_seconds must be finite and between 0 and {metadata.max_timeout_seconds}")
        try:
            # The same detached JSON snapshot is validated, authorized, and run;
            # another thread cannot mutate the caller's dictionary after review.
            payload = json.loads(canonical_json(payload))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise InputValidationError(str(exc)) from exc
        validate_json_schema(payload, metadata.input_schema)
        try:
            self.policy.validate(plugin, payload, context)
        except Exception:
            try:
                audit_event("denied", plugin_id, context.request_id, context.actor)
            except Exception:
                pass  # Never execute when the denial itself cannot be logged.
            raise
        audit_event("started", plugin_id, context.request_id, context.actor)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            with execution_scope(timeout_seconds=timeout):
                health = plugin.health()
                if not health.available:
                    raise ToolUnavailableError(health.message or f"plugin {plugin_id} is unavailable")
                check_execution()
                admission = _ADMITTED_REQUEST.set((id(plugin), id(payload), id(context)))
                try:
                    data = plugin.run(payload, context)
                finally:
                    _ADMITTED_REQUEST.reset(admission)
                check_execution()
                canonical_json(data)
                data = redact_data(data, context.environment)
                validate_json_schema(data, metadata.output_schema)
                check_execution()
            duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
            audit_event("succeeded", plugin_id, context.request_id, context.actor)
            return PluginResult(plugin_id=metadata.plugin_id, plugin_version=metadata.version,
                                request_id=context.request_id, actor=context.actor, ok=True,
                                duration_ms=duration_ms, data=data)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
            try:
                event = "cancelled" if isinstance(exc, ExecutionCancelledError) else "failed"
                audit_event(event, plugin_id, context.request_id, context.actor)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if raise_errors:
                raise
            return PluginResult(plugin_id=metadata.plugin_id, plugin_version=metadata.version,
                                request_id=context.request_id, actor=context.actor, ok=False,
                                duration_ms=duration_ms,
                                error={"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": redact_text(str(exc), context.environment)[:2048]})
        except BaseException:
            try:
                audit_event("cancelled", plugin_id, context.request_id, context.actor)
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise


def dumps_json(payload: Any) -> str:
    """Serialize data using ORION's canonical pretty JSON representation."""
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)

"""Cooperative deadlines shared by runtime, adapters, and trusted worker threads. This is not an operating-system sandbox. Python code must reach a checkpoint; subprocess adapters additionally enforce...

"""Cooperative deadlines shared by runtime, adapters, and trusted worker threads.

This is not an operating-system sandbox. Python code must reach a checkpoint;
subprocess adapters additionally enforce their deadline while waiting for a child.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import threading
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from contextvars import ContextVar
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterator


class ExecutionCancelledError(RuntimeError):
    """An operator or disconnected client cancelled this execution."""


class ExecutionCancellation:
    """Thread-safe cancellation token; cancellation remains set once requested."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._event = threading.Event()

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        """Signal running work to stop at its next checkpoint."""
        self._event.set()

    @property
    def cancelled(self) -> bool:
        """Whether cancellation has been requested."""
        return self._event.is_set()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _ExecutionBudget:
    deadline: float | None = None
    cancellations: tuple[ExecutionCancellation, ...] = ()


_CURRENT: ContextVar[_ExecutionBudget] = ContextVar("orion_execution_budget", default=_ExecutionBudget())


def _positive_timeout(value: float) -> float:
    if type(value) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0:
        raise ValueError("timeout_seconds must be finite and positive")
    return float(value)


@contextmanager
def execution_scope(*, timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
                    cancellation: ExecutionCancellation | None = None) -> Iterator[None]:
    """Nest an execution budget without extending an inherited deadline.

    Enter this context in the worker thread that executes a synchronous runtime.
    The cancellation token itself may be signalled from any thread.
    """
    parent = _CURRENT.get()
    deadline = parent.deadline
    if timeout_seconds is not None:
        requested = time.monotonic() + _positive_timeout(timeout_seconds)
        deadline = requested if deadline is None else min(deadline, requested)
    cancellations = parent.cancellations
    if cancellation is not None:
        if not isinstance(cancellation, ExecutionCancellation):
            raise TypeError("cancellation must be an ExecutionCancellation token")
        cancellations += (cancellation,)
    token = _CURRENT.set(_ExecutionBudget(deadline, cancellations))
    try:
        check_execution()
        yield
    finally:
        _CURRENT.reset(token)


def check_execution() -> None:
    """Raise when the current execution has been cancelled or has expired."""
    current = _CURRENT.get()
    if any(token.cancelled for token in current.cancellations):
        raise ExecutionCancelledError("execution was cancelled")
    if current.deadline is not None and time.monotonic() >= current.deadline:
        raise TimeoutError("execution deadline exceeded")


def remaining_timeout(requested: float) -> float:
    """Limit a finite socket or process timeout to the shared time remaining."""
    timeout = _positive_timeout(requested)
    check_execution()
    deadline = _CURRENT.get().deadline
    if deadline is None:
        return timeout
    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
    if remaining <= 0:
        raise TimeoutError("execution deadline exceeded")
    return min(timeout, remaining)

"""Safe adapters for established OSINT tools.

Third-party projects remain separate installations. ORION invokes trusted local
executables or a configured SpiderFoot service with bounded, structured input.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from ipaddress import ip_address
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping

from .adapters import (
    TemporaryToolDirectory,
    ToolRunner,
    ToolSpec,
    collect_artifacts,
    parse_json_output,
)
from .core import BasePlugin, JsonObject, PluginContext, PluginHealth, PluginMetadata
from .execution import check_execution, execution_scope, remaining_timeout

_GENERIC_OUTPUT_SCHEMA: JsonObject = {
    "type": "object",
    "required": ["tool", "result"],
    "properties": {
        "tool": {"type": "string"},
        "result": {},
        "execution": {"type": "object"},
        "artifacts": {"type": "object"},
    },
}


def _timeout(payload: Mapping[str, Any], default: float = 120.0) -> float:
    return float(payload.get("timeout_seconds", default))


def _argument_value(value: str, label: str) -> str:
    """Reject data that an external argparse/Cobra parser may interpret as flags."""
    if (not value or value != value.strip() or value.startswith("-")
            or any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in value)):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be nonempty data without option prefixes or control characters")
    return value


def _domain(value: str) -> str:
    _argument_value(value, "domain")
    labels = value.removesuffix(".").split(".")
    if any(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?", label) is None for label in labels):
        raise ValueError("domain must contain valid DNS labels")
    return value


def _web_url(value: str) -> str:
    _argument_value(value, "url")
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(value)
    if (parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname
            or parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None
            or any(char.isspace() for char in value)):
        raise ValueError("url must be an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials or whitespace")
    if parsed.port is not None and not 1 <= parsed.port <= 65535:
        raise ValueError("url port must be between 1 and 65535")
    return value


def _execution_result(tool_id: str, execution: JsonObject, artifacts: JsonObject | None = None) -> JsonObject:
    parsed = parse_json_output(str(execution.get("stdout", "")))
    result: JsonObject = {
        "tool": tool_id,
        "result": parsed if parsed is not None else execution.get("stdout", ""),
        "execution": {
            "return_code": execution["return_code"],
            "duration_ms": execution["duration_ms"],
            "stderr": execution.get("stderr", ""),
            "stdout_truncated": execution.get("stdout_truncated", False),
            "stderr_truncated": execution.get("stderr_truncated", False),
        },
    }
    if artifacts:
        result["artifacts"] = artifacts
    return result


class ExternalCommandPlugin(BasePlugin):
    """Base class for allow-listed third-party command adapters."""

    tool_spec: ToolSpec

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.runner = ToolRunner(self.tool_spec)

    def health(self) -> PluginHealth:
        return self.runner.health()


class SpiderFootPlugin(BasePlugin):
    metadata = PluginMetadata(
        plugin_id="spiderfoot",
        name="SpiderFoot",
        version="1.0.0",
        category="osint-automation",
        description="Controls an authorized SpiderFoot service and returns normalized scan data.",
        risk_level="medium",
        capabilities=("scan-start", "scan-list", "scan-results"),
        requires_authorization=True,
        network_access=True,
        side_effects=True,
        default_timeout_seconds=60,
        max_timeout_seconds=600,
        tags=("osint", "spiderfoot", "service-adapter", "read-mostly"),
        homepage="https://github.com/smicallef/spiderfoot",
        license="MIT",
        integration="http-api",
        input_schema={
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["operation"],
            "additionalProperties": False,
            "properties": {
                "operation": {"type": "string", "enum": ["start", "list", "results", "summary"]},
                "server_url": {"type": "string", "pattern": r"^https?://", "maxLength": 2048},
                "target": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 2048},
                "scan_id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128},
                "name": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128},
                "use_case": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 128},
                "modules": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "maxItems": 250,
                    "uniqueItems": True,
                    "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128},
                },
                "types": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "maxItems": 250,
                    "uniqueItems": True,
                    "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128},
                },
                "timeout_seconds": {"type": "number", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 600},
            },
        },
        output_schema=_GENERIC_OUTPUT_SCHEMA,
    )

    def requests_side_effects(self, payload: JsonObject) -> bool:
        return payload.get("operation") == "start"

    def run(self, payload: JsonObject, context: PluginContext) -> JsonObject:
        payload = self.authorize(payload, context)
        operation = str(payload["operation"])
        server = str(payload.get("server_url", "http://127.0.0.1:5001")).rstrip("/")
        self._validate_local_service(server)
        parsed_server = urllib.parse.urlsplit(server)
        if parsed_server.hostname == "localhost":
            port = f":{parsed_server.port}" if parsed_server.port is not None else ""
            # An OS hosts/DNS configuration must never redirect localhost to a
            # remote service. HTTPS still performs normal certificate checks.
            server = f"{parsed_server.scheme}://127.0.0.1{port}"
        timeout = _timeout(payload, 60)

        if operation == "start":
            target = str(payload.get("target", "")).strip()
            if not target:
                raise ValueError("target is required for SpiderFoot start")
            fields = {
                "scanname": str(payload.get("name", f"ORION-{target}")),
                "scantarget": target,
                "modulelist": ",".join(payload.get("modules", [])),
                "typelist": ",".join(payload.get("types", [])),
                "usecase": str(payload.get("use_case", "all")),
            }
            result = self._request(f"{server}/startscan", timeout, fields)
        elif operation == "list":
            result = self._request(f"{server}/scanlist", timeout)
        else:
            scan_id = str(payload.get("scan_id", "")).strip()
            if not scan_id:
                raise ValueError(f"scan_id is required for SpiderFoot {operation}")
            endpoint = "scansummary" if operation == "summary" else "scanexportjsonmulti"
            parameters = {"id": scan_id, "by": "type"} if operation == "summary" else {"ids": scan_id}
            query = urllib.parse.urlencode(parameters)
            result = self._request(f"{server}/{endpoint}?{query}", timeout)
        return {"tool": "spiderfoot", "result": result}

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_local_service(server: str) -> None:
        """Only an explicit local SpiderFoot service; never a remote target URL."""
        if any(char.isspace() or ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in server):
            raise ValueError("SpiderFoot server_url must not contain whitespace or control characters")
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(server)
        if (parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname
                or parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None
                or parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.path not in {"", "/"}
                or "%" in parsed.hostname):
            raise ValueError("SpiderFoot server_url must be a plain local HTTP(S) origin")
        if parsed.hostname != "localhost":
            try:
                if not ip_address(parsed.hostname).is_loopback:
                    raise ValueError("SpiderFoot service must be loopback-only")
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ValueError("SpiderFoot server must use localhost or a loopback IP literal") from exc
        try:
            if parsed.port is not None and not 1 <= parsed.port <= 65535:
                raise ValueError("invalid port")
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError("invalid SpiderFoot local port") from exc

    @staticmethod
    def _request(url: str, timeout: float, fields: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> Any:
        parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        SpiderFootPlugin._validate_local_service(f"{parsed_url.scheme}://{parsed_url.netloc}")
        if parsed_url.hostname == "localhost":
            raise ValueError("SpiderFoot requests require a pinned loopback IP literal")
        data = urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode("utf-8") if fields else None
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method="POST" if fields else "GET")
        request.add_header("Accept", "application/json")
        class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
            def redirect_request(self, req: Any, fp: Any, code: int, msg: str,
                                 headers: Any, newurl: str) -> None:
                return None

        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}), NoRedirect())
        try:
            with execution_scope(timeout_seconds=timeout), opener.open(request, timeout=remaining_timeout(timeout)) as response:
                raw_bytes = bytearray()
                read_chunk = getattr(response, "read1", response.read)
                while True:
                    check_execution()
                    chunk = read_chunk(min(65536, 1024 * 1024 + 1 - len(raw_bytes)))
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    raw_bytes.extend(chunk)
                    if len(raw_bytes) > 1024 * 1024:
                        raise ValueError("SpiderFoot response exceeds the 1 MiB limit")
                check_execution()
                raw = raw_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            exc.close()
            raise RuntimeError(f"SpiderFoot HTTP {exc.code}; check the local service configuration") from None
        parsed = parse_json_output(raw)
        return parsed if parsed is not None else raw

"""Platform-specific cleanup for trusted external command adapters.""" from __future__ import annotations import os

"""Platform-specific cleanup for trusted external command adapters."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import signal
import subprocess
from typing import Any


class ProcessGroup:
    """Own a POSIX session or Windows kill-on-close job for one tool invocation.

    The executable is trusted local code, not a hostile-program sandbox. On
    Windows assignment follows process creation; on POSIX a child can explicitly
    leave its process group. Neither mechanism restricts filesystem or network.
    """

    def __init__(self, process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
        self.process = process
        self._job: Any = None
        self._kernel: Any = None
        if os.name == "nt":
            self._attach_windows_job()

    def _attach_windows_job(self) -> None:
        import ctypes
        from ctypes import wintypes

        class BasicLimits(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [("PerProcessUserTimeLimit", ctypes.c_longlong),
                        ("PerJobUserTimeLimit", ctypes.c_longlong),
                        ("LimitFlags", wintypes.DWORD), ("MinimumWorkingSetSize", ctypes.c_size_t),
                        ("MaximumWorkingSetSize", ctypes.c_size_t), ("ActiveProcessLimit", wintypes.DWORD),
                        ("Affinity", ctypes.c_size_t), ("PriorityClass", wintypes.DWORD),
                        ("SchedulingClass", wintypes.DWORD)]

        class IoCounters(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [(name, ctypes.c_ulonglong) for name in (
                "ReadOperationCount", "WriteOperationCount", "OtherOperationCount",
                "ReadTransferCount", "WriteTransferCount", "OtherTransferCount")]

        class ExtendedLimits(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [("BasicLimitInformation", BasicLimits), ("IoInfo", IoCounters),
                        ("ProcessMemoryLimit", ctypes.c_size_t), ("JobMemoryLimit", ctypes.c_size_t),
                        ("PeakProcessMemoryUsed", ctypes.c_size_t), ("PeakJobMemoryUsed", ctypes.c_size_t)]

        kernel = getattr(ctypes, "WinDLL")("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
        kernel.CreateJobObjectW.argtypes = (ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.LPCWSTR)
        kernel.CreateJobObjectW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        kernel.SetInformationJobObject.argtypes = (wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.DWORD)
        kernel.SetInformationJobObject.restype = wintypes.BOOL
        kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject.argtypes = (wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.HANDLE)
        kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject.restype = wintypes.BOOL
        kernel.OpenProcess.argtypes = (wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD)
        kernel.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        kernel.TerminateJobObject.argtypes = (wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.UINT)
        kernel.TerminateJobObject.restype = wintypes.BOOL
        kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = (wintypes.HANDLE,)
        kernel.CloseHandle.restype = wintypes.BOOL

        job = kernel.CreateJobObjectW(None, None)
        if not job:
            raise OSError("could not create Windows subprocess cleanup job")
        process_handle = None
        try:
            limits = ExtendedLimits()
            limits.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = 0x2000  # JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE
            if not kernel.SetInformationJobObject(job, 9, ctypes.byref(limits), ctypes.sizeof(limits)):
                raise OSError("could not configure Windows subprocess cleanup job")
            # PROCESS_SET_QUOTA | PROCESS_TERMINATE; avoid private Popen handles.
            process_handle = kernel.OpenProcess(0x0100 | 0x0001, False, self.process.pid)
            if not process_handle or not kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject(job, process_handle):
                # A tiny command may already have exited before assignment.
                if self.process.poll() is None:
                    raise OSError("could not attach tool to Windows subprocess cleanup job")
        except BaseException:
            kernel.CloseHandle(job)
            raise
        finally:
            if process_handle:
                kernel.CloseHandle(process_handle)
        self._kernel, self._job = kernel, job

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Terminate this invocation and its owned descendants; safe to repeat."""
        if self._job is not None:
            self._kernel.TerminateJobObject(self._job, 1)
            self._kernel.CloseHandle(self._job)
            self._job = None
        stop_process(self.process)


def stop_process(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
    """Fallback cleanup, including a whole dedicated process group on POSIX."""
    if os.name == "posix":
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            return
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
    if process.poll() is None:
        try:
            process.kill()
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass

"""Redact explicitly supplied secrets before returning external-tool output.""" from __future__ import annotations import json

"""Redact explicitly supplied secrets before returning external-tool output."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from typing import Any, Mapping
from urllib.parse import quote, quote_plus

_SECRET_NAME = re.compile(r"(?:TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|CREDENTIAL|API_KEY|ACCESS_KEY|PRIVATE_KEY)", re.I)


def redact_text(text: str, environment: Mapping[str, str] | None) -> str:
    """Remove known secret values and common JSON/URL encodings.

    This cannot infer credentials generated by a third-party program or arbitrary
    transformations of secrets. Caller-supplied credentials stay in environment
    variables and must not be deliberately printed by trusted tools.
    """
    if not environment:
        return text
    replacements: set[str] = set()
    for key, value in environment.items():
        if isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(value, str) and value and _SECRET_NAME.search(key):
            replacements.update((value, json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True)[1:-1],
                                 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)[1:-1], quote(value, safe=""), quote_plus(value)))
    for secret in sorted(replacements, key=len, reverse=True):
        text = text.replace(secret, "[REDACTED]")
    return text


def redact_data(value: Any, environment: Mapping[str, str] | None) -> Any:
    """Return a JSON-shaped copy with known secrets removed from strings and keys."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return redact_text(value, environment)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [redact_data(item, environment) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {redact_text(key, environment): redact_data(item, environment) for key, item in value.items()}
    return value

"""Bounded validation for the explicitly supported ORION schema vocabulary.""" from __future__ import annotations import math

"""Bounded validation for the explicitly supported ORION schema vocabulary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from typing import Any, Mapping

from orion.jsonio import canonical_json

from .errors import InputValidationError

_JSON_TYPES: dict[str, type[Any] | tuple[type[Any], ...]] = {
    "object": dict, "array": list, "string": str, "integer": int,
    "number": (int, float), "boolean": bool, "null": type(None),
}

_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS = {
    "type", "oneOf", "anyOf", "allOf", "not", "const", "enum", "properties", "required",
    "additionalProperties", "items", "minItems", "maxItems", "uniqueItems", "minLength", "maxLength",
    "pattern", "minimum", "maximum", "exclusiveMinimum", "exclusiveMaximum", "minProperties", "maxProperties",
    "$schema", "$id", "$comment", "title", "description", "default", "examples", "deprecated", "readOnly", "writeOnly",
}


def _is_type(value: Any, expected: str) -> bool:
    if expected == "integer":
        return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "number":
        return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    return isinstance(value, _JSON_TYPES[expected])


def _json_equal(left: Any, right: Any) -> bool:
    """Use JSON scalar identity; Python treats True == 1, but JSON does not."""
    if isinstance(left, bool) or isinstance(right, bool):
        return type(left) is type(right) and left == right
    if isinstance(left, (int, float)) and isinstance(right, (int, float)):
        return left == right
    if type(left) is not type(right):
        return False
    if isinstance(left, list):
        return len(left) == len(right) and all(_json_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right))
    if isinstance(left, dict):
        return left.keys() == right.keys() and all(_json_equal(left[k], right[k]) for k in left)
    return bool(left == right)


def _json_identity(value: Any) -> Any:
    """A hashable JSON identity with numbers equivalent and booleans distinct."""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return ("boolean", value)
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return ("number", value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return ("array", tuple(_json_identity(item) for item in value))
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return ("object", tuple((key, _json_identity(item)) for key, item in sorted(value.items())))
    return (type(value).__name__, value)


def validate_json_schema(value: Any, schema: Mapping[str, Any] | bool, path: str = "$") -> None:
    """Validate bounded JSON against ORION's supported schema vocabulary.

    Unsupported assertion keywords fail closed; this is intentionally not a
    general-purpose JSON Schema 2020-12 implementation.
    """
    try:
        canonical_json(value)
        canonical_json(dict(schema) if isinstance(schema, Mapping) else schema)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: {exc}") from exc
    _validate_schema_definition(schema, path)
    _validate_schema_node(value, schema, path)


def _validate_schema_definition(schema: Mapping[str, Any] | bool, path: str) -> None:
    """Check every branch before evaluation, including unused anyOf/not branches."""
    if isinstance(schema, bool):
        return
    if not isinstance(schema, Mapping):
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: schema must be an object or boolean")
    unknown = set(schema) - _SCHEMA_KEYWORDS
    if unknown:
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: unsupported schema keywords: {sorted(unknown)}")
    if "type" in schema:
        expected = schema["type"]
        types = [expected] if isinstance(expected, str) else expected
        if (not isinstance(types, list) or not types
                or any(not isinstance(item, str) or item not in _JSON_TYPES for item in types)
                or len(set(types)) != len(types)):
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: invalid schema type declaration")
    for keyword in ("oneOf", "anyOf", "allOf"):
        if keyword in schema:
            choices = schema[keyword]
            if not isinstance(choices, list) or not choices:
                raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: {keyword} must contain schemas")
            for index, candidate in enumerate(choices):
                _validate_schema_definition(candidate, f"{path}.{keyword}[{index}]")
    for keyword in ("not", "items", "additionalProperties"):
        if keyword in schema:
            _validate_schema_definition(schema[keyword], f"{path}.{keyword}")
    if "properties" in schema:
        properties = schema["properties"]
        if not isinstance(properties, Mapping):
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: properties must be an object")
        for key, candidate in properties.items():
            _validate_schema_definition(candidate, f"{path}.properties.{key}")
    if "required" in schema:
        required = schema["required"]
        if (not isinstance(required, list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in required)
                or len(set(required)) != len(required)):
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: required must contain unique property names")
    if "enum" in schema and (not isinstance(schema["enum"], list) or not schema["enum"]):
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: enum must be a nonempty array")
    for keyword in ("minItems", "maxItems", "minLength", "maxLength", "minProperties", "maxProperties"):
        if keyword in schema and (type(schema[keyword]) is not int or schema[keyword] < 0):
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: {keyword} must be a nonnegative integer")
    for keyword in ("minimum", "maximum", "exclusiveMinimum", "exclusiveMaximum"):
        if keyword in schema and type(schema[keyword]) not in {int, float}:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: {keyword} must be a finite number")
    if "uniqueItems" in schema and type(schema["uniqueItems"]) is not bool:
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: uniqueItems must be boolean")
    if "pattern" in schema:
        if not isinstance(schema["pattern"], str):
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: pattern must be a regular expression string")
        try:
            re.compile(schema["pattern"])
        except re.error as exc:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: pattern is not a valid regular expression") from exc


def _validate_schema_node(value: Any, schema: Mapping[str, Any] | bool, path: str) -> None:
    if isinstance(schema, bool):
        if not schema:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: schema does not permit this value")
        return
    if not isinstance(schema, Mapping):
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: schema must be an object or boolean")
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: numbers must be finite")
    if "oneOf" in schema:
        successes = 0
        errors: list[str] = []
        for candidate in schema["oneOf"]:
            try:
                _validate_schema_node(value, candidate, path)
                successes += 1
            except InputValidationError as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
        if successes != 1:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: expected exactly one oneOf match; matches={successes}; details={errors[:3]}")
    if "anyOf" in schema:
        errors = []
        for candidate in schema["anyOf"]:
            try:
                _validate_schema_node(value, candidate, path)
                break
            except InputValidationError as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
        else:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: no anyOf variant matched; details={errors[:3]}")
    for candidate in schema.get("allOf", []):
        _validate_schema_node(value, candidate, path)
    if "not" in schema:
        try:
            _validate_schema_node(value, schema["not"], path)
        except InputValidationError:
            pass
        else:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: value matches a forbidden schema")
    expected = schema.get("type")
    if expected:
        expected_types = [expected] if isinstance(expected, str) else list(expected)
        unknown = [item for item in expected_types if item not in _JSON_TYPES]
        if unknown:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: unsupported schema types: {unknown}")
        if not any(_is_type(value, item) for item in expected_types):
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: expected {expected_types}, received {type(value).__name__}")
    if "const" in schema and not _json_equal(value, schema["const"]):
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: must equal {schema['const']!r}")
    if "enum" in schema and not any(_json_equal(value, item) for item in schema["enum"]):
        raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: value is outside the allowed enum")
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        missing = [key for key in schema.get("required", []) if key not in value]
        if missing:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: missing required fields {missing}")
        properties: Mapping[str, Any] = schema.get("properties", {})
        if "minProperties" in schema and len(value) < schema["minProperties"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: too few object properties")
        if "maxProperties" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxProperties"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: too many object properties")
        if schema.get("additionalProperties") is False:
            unexpected = sorted(set(value) - set(properties))
            if unexpected:
                raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: unknown fields {unexpected}")
        for key, child_schema in properties.items():
            if key in value:
                _validate_schema_node(value[key], child_schema, f"{path}.{key}")
        additional = schema.get("additionalProperties")
        if isinstance(additional, Mapping):
            for key in set(value) - set(properties):
                _validate_schema_node(value[key], additional, f"{path}.{key}")
    if isinstance(value, list):
        if schema.get("minItems") is not None and len(value) < schema["minItems"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: requires at least {schema['minItems']} items")
        if schema.get("maxItems") is not None and len(value) > schema["maxItems"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: allows at most {schema['maxItems']} items")
        if schema.get("uniqueItems"):
            rendered = [_json_identity(item) for item in value]
            if len(set(rendered)) != len(rendered):
                raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: duplicate items are not allowed")
        if "items" in schema:
            for index, item in enumerate(value):
                _validate_schema_node(item, schema["items"], f"{path}[{index}]")
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if schema.get("minLength") is not None and len(value) < schema["minLength"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: minimum length is {schema['minLength']}")
        if schema.get("maxLength") is not None and len(value) > schema["maxLength"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: maximum length is {schema['maxLength']}")
        pattern = schema.get("pattern")
        if pattern and re.search(pattern, value) is None:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: value does not match the required pattern")
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        if schema.get("minimum") is not None and value < schema["minimum"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: must be >= {schema['minimum']}")
        if schema.get("exclusiveMinimum") is not None and value <= schema["exclusiveMinimum"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: must be > {schema['exclusiveMinimum']}")
        if schema.get("maximum") is not None and value > schema["maximum"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: must be <= {schema['maximum']}")
        if schema.get("exclusiveMaximum") is not None and value >= schema["exclusiveMaximum"]:
            raise InputValidationError(f"{path}: must be < {schema['exclusiveMaximum']}")
